principles: On-demand sections for large review bodies
No whole-corpus loading for normal tasks
No duplicated large preambles across source templates

approved_exceptions.setup-gbrain/SKILL.md.tmpl: pre-existing oversized setup workflow; outside this package wave
approved_exceptions.land-and-deploy/SKILL.md.tmpl: pre-existing oversized release workflow; outside this package wave
approved_exceptions.retro/SKILL.md.tmpl: pre-existing oversized retrospective workflow; outside this package wave
approved_exceptions.codex/SKILL.md.tmpl: pre-existing oversized Codex wrapper; outside this package wave

enforcement: CI measures source templates, generated primary SKILL.md files, and generated/template sections
Autoplan must remain carved into an on-demand section
Large pre-existing source routers require explicit policy exceptions
Selectors and skill routers must return bounded context unless a full audit is explicitly requested
